title: NIST Software Assurance Metrics and Tool Evaluation (SAMATE) program
applicability: Reference program for scanner validation methodology (bug classes, reference corpus, SATE). Applies to Echelon only as a voluntary methodology reference for scanner benchmarking.
license: US government work; generally not subject to copyright in the US. Publicly available; cite and paraphrase only, do not reproduce substantial text.
limitations: Program page does not certify, accredit or endorse tools; benchmarking against SAMATE material is not accreditation.

verification.method: fetched issuer page

title: NIST Software Assurance Reference Dataset (SARD), including Juliet test suites
version: SARD live dataset; Juliet C# 1.3 (suite 110, 28,942 cases), Juliet Java 1.3 (28,881), Juliet C/C++ 1.3.1 (64,099)
applicability: Candidate calibration corpus for C# and Java scanners used alongside F# code. No F# test cases exist in SARD; languages listed are C, C++, Java, PHP and C#.
license: Per-suite terms not stated on the listing page; check each download before redistribution.
limitations: Synthetic test cases; academic studies show synthetic performance overstates real-world detection. Not usable directly for F#.

verification.method: fetched SARD home and test-suites listing pages

title: NIST SP 500-326 SATE V Report: Ten Years of Static Analysis Tool Expositions
version: SATE V report (SP 500-326, October 2018); SATE VI workshop September 2019
applicability: Methodology reference for credible scanner evaluation and for how not to present results (no ranking).
license: US government work. Publicly available; cite and paraphrase only, do not reproduce substantial text.
limitations: The report states its analysis should not be used as a basis for rating or choosing tools and that SATE should not be interpreted as a tool testing exercise. SATE VI results were reported at a 2019 workshop; no later edition located.

verification.method: downloaded NIST SP 500-326 PDF and read caution section

notes: Exact wording located: 'our analysis should NOT be used as a basis for rating or choosing tools; this was never the goal.'

title: OWASP Benchmark project
version: v1.2 (Java, 2,740 test cases in expectedresults-1.2.csv across 11 categories); Python suite also listed
applicability: Calibration benchmark for SAST, DAST and IAST tools on Java and Python. Not applicable to F# code; useful only to calibrate tool pipelines and scoring harnesses.
limitations: Synthetic; vendors can tune to it; the project page itself does not state the scoring formula (scorecards are in BenchmarkUtils and reference Youden's index). No .NET suite.

verification.method: fetched project page and expectedresults-1.2.csv from BenchmarkJava repository
